title: Monitors implementation, testing and resource use
statement: Retrospect collects CI timings, test results, coverage and runner usage from the repos it watches.

criteria.then: each finished job becomes a signal with stage, queue time, duration and runner minutes

criteria.given: runs already collected, jobs not yet finished, or more than 100 runs
criteria.then: seen runs are skipped, unfinished jobs are ignored and results are paged
every test case yields its suite, name, duration and outcome
line and branch coverage percentages are summed across files

criteria.given: the GitHub API returns an error
criteria.then: the error is raised, never silently ignored
common names map to standard stages and per-repo overrides win
